sources.title: Hierarchical processing in spoken language comprehension
sources.key_findings: fMRI evidence for hierarchical speech processing in temporal lobe: HG sensitive to acoustic distortion, STG/STS sensitive to intelligibility, higher regions sensitive to semantics
sources.relevance: 核心层级结构证据；直接支持STG-STS是可懂度处理核心位点

sources.title: The cortical organization of speech processing
sources.key_findings: Dual-stream model: ventral stream (bilateral, sound-to-meaning) + dorsal stream (left-lateralized, sound-to-motor)
sources.relevance: 经典双流模型综述，内容通过后续引用文献理解

sources.title: Predictive top-down integration of prior knowledge during speech perception
sources.key_findings: IFG responds to prior knowledge before STG; STG response decreases with matching priors (prediction error minimization); subjective intelligibility increases with correct priors
sources.relevance: 预测编码框架的核心证据；时序（IFG先，STG后）和方向（STG减弱）支持自上而下预测

sources.title: Prediction errors but not sharpened signals simulate multivoxel fMRI patterns during speech perception
sources.key_findings: Posterior STS multivoxel patterns match prediction error model, not sharpened signal model; direct comparison of competing predictive coding accounts
sources.relevance: 区分预测误差vs增强信号模型的关键实验；支持STS是预测误差节点

sources.title: Perceptual learning of degraded speech by minimizing prediction error
sources.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences USA
sources.key_findings: Short-term prior knowledge effects and long-term perceptual learning share the same neural mechanism (STG response reduction); both driven by prediction error minimization
sources.relevance: 即时感知和长期学习统一机制；支持预测编码是语音学习的核心算法

sources.title: Neural prediction errors distinguish perception and misperception of speech
sources.key_findings: Left STS prediction error signals are stronger for correct perception vs misperception; misperception arises from insufficient prediction error (not over-reliance on priors)
sources.relevance: 区分正确感知vs误感知的神经机制；证明预测误差充分性而非绝对量决定感知正确性

sources.title: The encoding of speech sounds in the superior temporal gyrus
sources.key_findings: STG posterior-to-anterior functional gradient; context-dependent phonological representations via recurrent connections; lexical context activates unheard phoneme representations ~300ms ahead
sources.relevance: STG内部功能梯度和语境预测性激活的综合综述

sources.title: Temporal lobe perceptual predictions for speech are instantiated in motor cortex and reconciled by inferior frontal cortex
sources.key_findings: Precentral gyrus (motor cortex) instantiates speech predictions; IFG reconciles predictions with sensory error; frontal neurodegeneration impairs prediction flexibility
sources.relevance: 分析-合成假说的7T fMRI直接支持；运动皮层参与听觉预测的新证据（摘要仅读，未独立重复）

sources.title: Current controversies on Wernicke's area and its role in language
sources.key_findings: Wernicke's area supports phonological form retrieval (for speech output), not comprehension; damage causes conduction aphasia; true comprehension is distributed over bilateral temporal-parietal-frontal network
sources.relevance: 韦尼克区功能的现代批判性综述；摘要仅读

sources.title: Speech perception at the interface of neurobiology and linguistics
sources.journal: Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society of London B
sources.key_findings: Multi-timescale processing: phoneme (20-80ms), syllable (150-300ms), phrase (500ms+); analysis-by-synthesis framework; neural oscillations provide temporal sampling windows
sources.relevance: 多时间尺度框架和分析-合成假说的综合理论综述

sources.title: Maps and streams in the auditory cortex: nonhuman primates illuminate human speech processing
sources.key_findings: Hierarchical structure and functional streams in primate auditory cortex; linking nonhuman primate anatomy to human speech perception circuits
sources.relevance: 演化和比较神经解剖学背景；摘要仅读，文章中仅间接引用
